**Conversation Overview**

This conversation documents a single working session (chat 37) of an ongoing long-term project called "The Method 1.6" — a large, multi-volume document system with a Register, Spectra Compendium, Index of Indices, main text, and several compendia, all managed through a custom bundling/splitting/press pipeline. The person maintains an elaborate session-continuity protocol involving handoff documents, working registers with formal rulings, and numbered work packages. Claude operated as an autonomous build agent, executing a pre-defined work package (WP-2) and closing the session with a new build (BUILD-38) and handoff document (HANDOFF-39).

The session's primary accomplishment was executing WP-2: rewriting the Register's front-matter opening block from navigation-oriented prose ("How to read this register") to a statement of purpose ("Why this register is printed"), per Ruling 38 §3. This carried docket item D-1 inside it, which required re-measuring — not inheriting — three claims the front matter had made about the Register's own numbering. Two of those claims measured false (the absence count was 132, not thirteen; eleven numbers missing from the 203–354 range were absent from the grouped headings entirely, a clause no prior session had tested), and one was withdrawn under existing rulings. A new Register entry (1782) recorded the struck claims. The session also identified and corrected a stale locator for SPEC-11 (Spectra L948 → L990), repacked BUILD-38 with HANDOFF-39 as a bundle member after an initial premature pack, and added two new gate conditions (G0h covering `wc -l` vs. line-split disagreement on files without trailing newlines; G0e expanded to name `__pycache__` as a spurious 104th tree member created by spec-based instrument imports).

The person's protocol is highly disciplined and self-enforcing: every defect is re-tested rather than inherited, every anchor is asserted before use, every fixed point is measured after writing rather than predicted, and history is never edited to match the present. A recurring false state arrives through carried memory each session (referencing chat 19, BUILD-19/20, wrong ruling counts, and closed work items) and is to be recorded and discarded without refutation per Ruling 41 — this was the seventeenth consecutive session it appeared. SPEC-11 is the next open item; IOI-05 is blocked by Ruling 40 (tower constraint). The prompt for chat 38 is fully written in §6 of HANDOFF-39.

import re
p="The_Method_1_6___The_Register-2.md"
L=open(p,encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines()
print("wc -l:",len(L))
heads=[(i+1,l) for i,l in enumerate(L) if l.startswith("### ")]
fm=[h for h in heads if h[0]<73]
body=[h for h in heads if h[0]>=73]

print("line 73:",L[72][:60])
nums=[];grouped=0

    tok=h[4:].strip()
    ns=re.findall(r'\d+',tok.split("—")[0].split("-")[0] if False else tok)

        got=[int(x) for x in re.findall(r'\d+',m.group(1))]
        if len(got)>1: grouped+=1
        nums.extend(got)
print("numbers:",len(nums),"grouped headings:",grouped,"range:",min(nums),"-",max(nums))
EOF

input.command:
cd /home/claude/build && python3 - << 'EOF'
import importlib.util,re,glob,collections
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("rc","register_cites.py")
rc=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(rc)
R=open('The_Method_1_6___The_Register-2.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
ent=re.split(r'\n### (\d+(?:, \d+)*)\n',R)
byent=collections.Counter(); heads=set()
for i in range(1,len(ent),2):
    ids={int(x) for x in ent[i].split(', ')}; heads|=ids
    for n,k in rc.cites(ent[i+1]).items():
        if n not in ids: byent[n]+=k
bymain=rc.cites(open('The_Method_1_6-2.md',encoding='utf-8').read())
comp=collections.Counter()
for f in glob.glob('The_Method_1_6___*Compendium-2.md')+glob.glob('*Index_of_Indices-2.md')+['THE-LOWDIN-SOLUTION-2.md','The_Three_Body_Problem_for_Unknown_Masses_Lach-2.md']:
    comp+=rc.cites(open(f,encoding='utf-8').read())
allc=byent+bymain+comp
f=lambda s:len([n for n in s if n in heads])
print("heads:",len(heads))
print("RAW      byent %d | main %d | main∪comp %d | anywhere %d"%(len(byent),len(bymain),len(set(bymain)|set(comp)),len(allc)))
print("FILTERED byent %d | main %d | main∪comp %d | anywhere %d"%(f(byent),f(bymain),f(set(bymain)|set(comp)),f(allc)))
print("PRINTED  570 | 387 | 701 | 970")
top=[n for n,k in byent.most_common(40) if n in heads and k>=7]
print("cited 7+ by entries:",len(top),sorted(top))
print("cited but no entry:",len([n for n in allc if n not in heads]))
EOF
